title.purpose: The profile name below the artwork.

body.purpose: Short factual profile and thesis copy.

motion.name: character-ambient-loop
motion.purpose: Slow hair sway, one natural blink, and low-amplitude monitor, lamp, cursor, and city-light changes.

narrative.overview: One compact anime workspace loop adds personality, while native Markdown carries all factual meaning. The page remains short, calm, and unmistakably a GitHub profile.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained cool monitor light and warm lamp light.
No generated text inside the artwork.

rules.name: The Two-Light Rule
rules.body: The image has only two visual signals: cool screen light and warm lamp light. No extra neon colors are allowed.

rules.name: The Markdown Owns Meaning Rule
rules.body: Generated imagery never carries names, claims, code, slogans, or labels.

rules.name: The One Scene Rule
rules.body: Only the anime header creates atmosphere. No additional illustrated cards or decorative panels follow it.

dos: Do keep the header compact and visually secondary to the profile content.
Do keep animation environmental, slow, and information-free.
Do preserve the static reduced-motion fallback and meaningful alt text.
donts: Don't use oversized identity banners, fake interface copy, cyberpunk AI clichés, neural brains, holograms, glossy cards, or logo walls.
Don't add readable text, badges, trademarks, or motivational slogans inside the illustration.
Don't add bouncing, zooming, flashing, or high-density particle animation.
